name: Mixing MEXes
title: G. Mixing MEXes
legend:
You are given n arrays a1,a2,…,an.

The following operation is performed exactly once:

Choose any array among a1,a2,…,an. Suppose you've chosen array ai (1≤i≤n).
Choose any element in array ai. Suppose you've chosen the j-th element of ai, denoted by ai,j (1≤j≤|ai|, where |ai| denotes the length of array ai).
Choose any other array among a1,a2,…an that is not ai. Suppose you've chosen ak (1≤k≤n,k≠i).
Add ai,j to the back of array ak. Then, remove ai,j from ai.
The value of this operation (i,j,k) is defined as the sum of each array's MEX after the operation is performed. More formally, the value of an operation after the operation is performed is ∑
n
i=1
MEX(ai).

Evaluate the sum of the values of all possible distinct independent operations. Two operations are distinct if the ordered triple of integers (i,j,k) is different.

MEX(a) is defined as the smallest non-negative integer that is not present in the array. For example, MEX([1,2,0,5]) is 3, and MEX([1,2,4,9]) is 0.
input_spec:
The first line of the input contains a single integer t (1≤t≤104) — the number of test cases.

The first line of each test case contains a single integer n (2≤n≤2⋅105) — the number of arrays.

The next n lines start with li (1≤li≤105) — the length of the ith array — then contain li integers a1,a2,…,ali (0≤aij≤106) — the array ai.

It is guaranteed that the sum of li over all test cases does not exceed 2⋅105.
output_spec: For each test case, output the sum of the values of all possible distinct operations.
note:
For the first test case, we have 3 possible distinct operations:

i=1,j=1,k=2: The arrays are now [] and [0,1,2], which have a mex of 0 and 3 respectively, so the value of the operation is 3.
i=2,j=1,k=1: The arrays are now [0,1] and [2], which have a mex of 2 and 0 respectively, so the value of the operation is 2.
i=2,j=2,k=1: The arrays are now [0,2] and [1], which have a mex of 1 and 0 respectively, so the value of the operation is 1.

For the second test case, since no array contains a zero, the value of all operations will be 0.
